rules.name: The Soft Warmth Rule
rules.body: Avoid sterile pure whites or harsh pure blacks. Use Ivory and Deep Charcoal instead.

dos: Do use rounded corners and subtle arches for architectural framing.
Do rely on typography and whitespace for visual hierarchy.
donts: Don't use heavy color blocking or stark geometry.
Don't rely on color alone to indicate errors or success.
